response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats),''),'Unknown') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.hand, s.cnt AS tally, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess_over_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
